translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: 1 Koriyn
book.title: 1 KORIYN Pol Minj Nind Ak Koriyn Biynimb Kuyip Tikak

content: Pol Krays Chinup Mon Kiros Bak Biyoŋ Kumak Minim Ak Aŋgñiyiŋgip
Pen mam ay sikop. Am nimb yip mindenik ñin ak, Gor minim niŋind yimb ak aŋgñiyn aŋgiy, minim kilrep wip gok ma aŋgñinik.
Jiysis Krays chinup aŋgiy kumak minim ak nep aŋgñen niŋniŋgiy aŋgiy,
minim aŋgrep ma ginim rek ayek niŋiy, jep jep diyiŋg, gos yomb niŋyiŋg nimbip aŋgñinik.
Biynimb gunap minim key piyow niŋiy, minim yindik andip andip ar kun ak nep rek aŋgun aŋgiy gipay rek ma ginik; Gor Kawnan ak yip gos ñakniŋ aŋgnik ak mey; miseŋ niŋnimimb rek ayak.
Kun ak minim tep timey ar gunap niŋiy, Gor nup gosimb ma niŋbim; nuk biynimb diyn aŋgiy key yimb gip ak niŋiy, nup gosimb niŋbim.
Gor Gosimb Tep Tep Nuk Ak

Pen yand kunep biynimb Gor nup chiŋgrep gipay gok niŋiy, kuyip minim yipul yimb ak aŋgñimbiyn. Pen biynimb yikop gok, biyomb kiyk apyap pikniŋg gispay gok sek minim yipul kiyk biynimb aŋgñimbay rek ma aŋgñimbiyn.

Minim yipul yand aŋgñimbiyn ak, Gor minim yipul yimb chinup dek, nuk yip mindrep giniŋgambun ak aŋgñimbiyn. Nuk miñmon ma alwol gayak ñin ak, biynimb yerer giy diniŋgamb minim ak niŋak ak pen; minim kun ak weygiy rek mindyiŋgip.
Biyomb ñin namb biy mindpay gok minim kun ak ma nep niŋbay. Niŋbiyap rek aŋgep, Biyomb chinup direp yimb gip ak nup, mon bak biyoŋ ma ñaŋgbirik aypiyap.
Pen Baybol buk ak tikiy aŋgyak, “Gor biynimb nup gok kuyip direp giniŋgamb. Windin ma niŋyak, aŋgñey ma niŋyak, kun giniŋgamb aŋgiy ma nep niŋyak ak; kuyip giniŋgamb aŋgyak.”
Pen minim ma niŋyiŋgipay kun ak, Gor Kawnan nuk ak chinup yokek apiy, gos ñek niŋbun. Yenen: Gor Kawnan ak Gor gip rek, giniŋgamb rek, maŋgiysek niŋimb.
Chin gos yerip yerip niŋbun ak biynimb gunap ma niŋbay, chin nep niŋbun rek, Kawnan nuk ak kunep gip. Nuk Gor gip rek niŋiy mey, chinup gos tep kun ak rek ñek niŋbun.
Kawnan lum biy nimb bap ma dipun; Gor Kawnan nuk yokek dipun ak mey; chinup direp yimb giniŋgamb ak niŋbun.

Bi gos tipaŋgiy niŋbay gunap, chinup minim kun ak aŋgey ma niŋbun; sikul aŋgiy ma niŋbun; Gor Kawnan gos ñimb rek minim kun ak niŋiy mey, biynimb gok kuyip aŋgñimbun. Gor Kawnan minim aŋgip ak niŋiy, biynimb Kawnan nuk sek mindpay gok kuyip aŋgñimbun.

Pen biynimb Kawnan nup ma dipay gok, minim nuk ak aŋgon niŋey minim rek ma ayip. Kun ak Gor Kawnan ak kiyk yip mindiy, gos ñakniŋ niŋniŋgiy rek ayip; yikop ak niŋey sakiy minim rek ayek, niŋrep ma gipay.
Pen biynimb Gor Kawnan yip mindpay gok, kinjeŋ tep ar ak timey ar ak aŋgiy kasek niŋiy, mindrep gey amek mey; biynimb gunap kuyip yenen kun gipim aŋgiy, aŋg giniŋgiy rek ma ayip.

content.text: “Biynimb an rek, Biyomb chin gos timund nuk ak kun giy mindip aŋgniŋgamb. Pen biynimb an rek, nup gos winjikniŋgamb aŋgyak.”

content: Pen Krays chinup biynimb nuk mindpun gok, gos nuk niŋimb rek ñakniŋ, niŋrep gipun.
